steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. Here is where you will stop reinventing wheels and start your standard-library survival kit (import, writing your own module, a guided tour of math, random, datetime, pathlib and collections, and installing packages in-app with micropip). The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
